narrative.overview: The site is a white gallery wall with a sales counter in front of it. Chrome is reduced to black type on white, with one pale lavender-grey (#e9eaf2) that grounds product tiles and the announcement bar. Colour comes almost entirely from photography and partner campaigns: Pantone, Swarovski and FIFA. Montserrat is the only typeface in use. Headlines are set at weight 600, which renders as 700, and run large (48px section headers, 56–76px on program pages). Product and campaign names are written in lowercase.
keyCharacteristics: Montserrat only: 600/700 headlines, 400/500 body, CTAs in uppercase at 500.
Black/white UI with #131417 near-black pill CTAs (100px radius).
Product imagery on #e9eaf2 tiles with a 16px radius and a soft 0 2px 4px shadow.
Fixed white 88px header: a 19px #e9eaf2 announcement bar above a 69px nav row with mega menus.
Lowercase product naming. Headings are almost never uppercase (2%).

rules.name: The Photography-Carries-Colour Rule
rules.body: UI chrome stays black, white and lavender-grey. Saturated colour shows up only in images, product swatch dots and partner campaigns.

rules.name: The Lowercase-Names Rule
rules.body: Product and campaign names stay lowercase ("motorola razr 70", "die brilliant collection"). Uppercase is reserved for CTA labels, which are transformed by CSS.

dos: **Do** set all type in Montserrat, using the three single-weight faces (400/500/700) so that 600 headings render as 700 as they do live.
**Do** use 100px pills for every CTA: #131417 solid or 1px #131417 outline, 16px/500 uppercase, `12px 24px` padding (`6px 12px` at 12px on mobile).
**Do** ground product imagery on #e9eaf2 tiles with 16px corners and `rgba(0,0,0,.16) 0 2px 4px`.
donts: **Don't** introduce coloured CTA fills on the AT pages. The only saturated CTA fill observed is the local #384ddd razr button on the US page.
**Don't** treat #cf4039 (the third-party feedback tab) or the logo purple #685bc6 as UI colours. Neither appears in brand UI CSS.
**Don't** uppercase headings. Only 2% of the crawl's headings are uppercase.
